theorem cubic_mixed_coefficient (p : ExteriorPoint) (H K L : Fin 4 → MetricField)
    (hH : ∀ a i j, ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (fun x => H a x i j) p.val)
    (hK : ∀ a i j, ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (fun x => K a x i j) p.val)
    (hL : ∀ a i j, ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (fun x => L a x i j) p.val) (i j : Fin 4) :
    mixedCoefficient p H K L i j =
      D4BMLinearizedEinsteinSource.residual p (ofMetricField (L 1) p.val) i j +
        secondVariation (backgroundSpace p) i j (fieldSpace p (H 0)) (fieldSpace p (K 1)) +
        secondVariation (backgroundSpace p) i j (fieldSpace p (H 1)) (fieldSpace p (K 0)) +
        thirdVariation (backgroundSpace p) i j (fieldSpace p (H 0)) (fieldSpace p (H 0))
          (fieldSpace p (H 1)) / 2
source_arguments.source_statement:
theorem cubic_mixed_coefficient (p : ExteriorPoint) (H K L : Fin 4 → MetricField)
    (hH : ∀ a i j, ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (fun x => H a x i j) p.val)
    (hK : ∀ a i j, ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (fun x => K a x i j) p.val)
    (hL : ∀ a i j, ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (fun x => L a x i j) p.val) (i j : Fin 4) :
    mixedCoefficient p H K L i j =
      D4BMLinearizedEinsteinSource.residual p (ofMetricField (L 1) p.val) i j +
        secondVariation (backgroundSpace p) i j (fieldSpace p (H 0)) (fieldSpace p (K 1)) +
        secondVariation (backgroundSpace p) i j (fieldSpace p (H 1)) (fieldSpace p (K 0)) +
        thirdVariation (backgroundSpace p) i j (fieldSpace p (H 0)) (fieldSpace p (H 0))
          (fieldSpace p (H 1)) / 2
source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  let B := secondVariation (backgroundSpace p) i j
  let C := thirdVariation (backgroundSpace p) i j
  have dh := fieldPath_jet_deriv p H hH
  have dk := fieldPath_jet_deriv p K hK
  have dl := fieldPath_jet_deriv p L hL
  have hb := ((hasDerivAt_const (0 : ℂ) B).clm_apply dh).clm_apply dk
  have hc := (((hasDerivAt_const (0 : ℂ) C).clm_apply dh).clm_apply dh).clm_apply dh
  have hl := (linear p i j).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt 0 dl
  have hd := (hl.add hb).add (hc.div_const 6)
  have he : (fun z => iteratedDeriv 3 (D4BMCorrectedMetricSource.source p
      (fieldPath H z) (fieldPath K z) (fieldPath L z) i j) 0 / 6) = fun z =>
      linear p i j (fieldSpace p (fieldPath L z)) +
        B (fieldSpace p (fieldPath H z)) (fieldSpace p (fieldPath K z)) +
        C (fieldSpace p (fieldPath H z)) (fieldSpace p (fieldPath H z))
          (fieldSpace p (fieldPath H z)) / 6 := by
    funext z
    rw [D4BMCorrectedMetricSource.source_cubic p _ _ _ (fieldPath_smooth p H hH z)
      (fieldPath_smooth p K hK z) (fieldPath_smooth p L hL z), linear_eq]
  unfold mixedCoefficient
  rw [he]
  calc
    _ = _ := hd.deriv
    _ = _ := by
      simp only [fieldPath_zero, zero_apply, zero_add, add_apply]
      rw [linear_eq]
      change _ + (B (fieldSpace p (H 1)) (fieldSpace p (K 0)) +
          B (fieldSpace p (H 0)) (fieldSpace p (K 1))) +
        ((C (fieldSpace p (H 1)) (fieldSpace p (H 0)) (fieldSpace p (H 0)) +
          C (fieldSpace p (H 0)) (fieldSpace p (H 1)) (fieldSpace p (H 0))) +
          C (fieldSpace p (H 0)) (fieldSpace p (H 0)) (fieldSpace p (H 1))) / 6 = _
      dsimp [C]
      rw [thirdVariation_symm_left (backgroundSpace p) (exterior_metric_det_ne_zero p) i j
          (fieldSpace p (H 1)) (fieldSpace p (H 0)) (fieldSpace p (H 0)),
        thirdVariation_symm_right (backgroundSpace p) (exterior_metric_det_ne_zero p) i j
          (fieldSpace p (H 0)) (fieldSpace p (H 1)) (fieldSpace p (H 0))]
      dsimp [B]
      ring

theorem linearIndependent_boundaryClass_iff {κ : Type u} (omega : I → κ → K) :
    LinearIndependent (Polynomial C)
        (fun p : κ => boundaryClass tau hC hfix hderiv fun i => omega i p) ↔
      ∀ l : κ →₀ Polynomial C, l ≠ 0 → ∀ k : K, ∃ i,

          ∑ p ∈ l.support, (Polynomial.aeval (derivC hC)) (l p) (omega i p)

theorem linearIndependent_boundaryClass_iff {κ : Type u} (omega : I → κ → K) :
    LinearIndependent (Polynomial C)
        (fun p : κ => boundaryClass tau hC hfix hderiv fun i => omega i p) ↔
      ∀ l : κ →₀ Polynomial C, l ≠ 0 → ∀ k : K, ∃ i,
        tau i k - k ≠
          ∑ p ∈ l.support, (Polynomial.aeval (derivC hC)) (l p) (omega i p)
source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  classical
  rw [linearIndependent_iff]
  constructor
  · intro hind l hl k
    by_contra hcon
    have hall : ∀ i, tau i k - k
        = ∑ p ∈ l.support, (Polynomial.aeval (derivC hC)) (l p) (omega i p) := by
      intro i
      by_contra hne
      exact hcon ⟨i, hne⟩
    apply hl
    refine hind l ?_
    rw [Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum]
    have hterm : ∀ p ∈ l.support,
        l p • boundaryClass tau hC hfix hderiv (fun i => omega i p)
          = boundaryClass tau hC hfix hderiv
            (fun i => (Polynomial.aeval (derivC hC)) (l p) (omega i p)) := by
      intro p _
      rw [boundaryClass_smul]
      congr 1
      funext i
      rw [aeval_derivPi_apply]
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hterm, ← boundaryClass_sum]
    refine (boundaryClass_eq_zero_iff tau hC hfix hderiv _).2 ⟨k, fun i => ?_⟩
    rw [Finset.sum_apply]
    exact (hall i).symm
  · intro hcrit l hl
    by_contra hne
    have hzero : boundaryClass tau hC hfix hderiv
        (∑ p ∈ l.support, fun i => (Polynomial.aeval (derivC hC)) (l p) (omega i p)) = 0 := by
      rw [boundaryClass_sum]
      have hterm : ∀ p ∈ l.support,
          boundaryClass tau hC hfix hderiv
            (fun i => (Polynomial.aeval (derivC hC)) (l p) (omega i p))
            = l p • boundaryClass tau hC hfix hderiv (fun i => omega i p) := by
        intro p _
        rw [boundaryClass_smul]
        congr 1
        funext i
        rw [aeval_derivPi_apply]
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hterm]
      rw [Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum] at hl
      exact hl
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := (boundaryClass_eq_zero_iff tau hC hfix hderiv _).1 hzero
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hcrit l hne k
    exact hi ((hk i).symm.trans (Finset.sum_apply _ _ _))

/-!
# Differential Bianchi algebra of a connection two-jet

The curvature and its first derivative are expanded from connection values and
first/second coordinate derivatives. Commuting coordinate second derivatives
force the cyclic covariant exterior derivative to vanish. Multiplication remains
noncommutative throughout, so the result applies to connection matrices.
-/

namespace GaloisForLFunctions.HTGeometry.ConnectionBianchi
variable {ι R : Type*} [Ring R]

/-- Curvature forced by connection values and first coordinate derivatives. -/
def curvature (A : ι → R) (D : ι → ι → R) (i j : ι) : R :=
  D i j - D j i + A i * A j - A j * A i

/-- Actual product-rule expression for the coordinate derivative of curvature. -/
def curvaturePartial (A : ι → R) (D : ι → ι → R) (H : ι → ι → ι → R)
    (k i j : ι) : R :=
  H k i j - H k j i + D k i * A j + A i * D k j - D k j * A i - A j * D k i

/-- Connection on endomorphisms applied to the curvature two-form. -/
def covariantExteriorPartial (A : ι → R) (D : ι → ι → R) (H : ι → ι → ι → R)
    (k i j : ι) : R :=
  curvaturePartial A D H k i j + A k * curvature A D i j - curvature A D i j * A k

/-- Curvature is alternating in the two coordinate-form indices. -/
theorem curvature_skew (A : ι → R) (D : ι → ι → R) (i j : ι) :
    curvature A D i j = -curvature A D j i := by
  unfold curvature
  abel

/-- Differential Bianchi identity follows from commuting coordinate derivatives. -/
theorem bianchi (A : ι → R) (D : ι → ι → R) (H : ι → ι → ι → R)

  have h₁ := hH k i j
  have h₂ := hH k j i
  have h₃ := hH i j k
  noncomm_ring [h₁, h₂, h₃]

    (F : SmirnovToeplitzNPlusElement

    SmirnovToeplitzNPlusElement U where
  toSmirnovToeplitzKernelElement :=
    { forward := F.toKernelElement.forward
      reflected := F.toKernelElement.reflected.mul
        (DiskSmirnovBoundary.ofMultiplier theta)
      boundary_relation := by
        filter_upwards [F.toKernelElement.boundary_relation,
          F.toKernelElement.reflected.boundary_mul_ae
            (DiskSmirnovBoundary.ofMultiplier theta),
          DiskSmirnovBoundary.boundary_ofMultiplier_ae theta,
          hthetaUnit] with x hF hmul htheta hunit
        rw [hmul, hF, htheta]
        simp only [smirnovToeplitzSymbolMul, map_mul]
        have hthetaConj :
